description: Authored lesson sequences for district-paced units whose membership is an INSTRUCTIONAL DECISION rather than the curriculum's own unit numbering. Hand-maintained and reviewed. Everything not listed here falls back to the curriculum manifest's unit membership, in manifest order.
note: Lesson ids ONLY. Titles, standards and routes resolve from data/curriculum-launch-manifest.json at render time, so a lesson renamed in the curriculum is renamed everywhere. Listing a lesson here does NOT move it: 2-6 remains canonically a Unit 2 lesson and still appears in Unit 2's own list.

PRE.reason: The Pre-Unit is assembled, not inherited. It is a Grade 5 review sequence drawn from several canonical units to rebuild the prerequisites Course 1 assumes — whole-number and decimal fluency before ratio reasoning starts in Unit 3. Reading its membership off the curriculum's unit-1 numbering produced 1-1 through 1-6, which is a different thing: the Unit 1 'Math Is…' arc, not the review the district actually paces here.
